# structured-output-parser
> Extract and repair JSON from LLM text output, with a fallback option

Extract JSON from LLM text output, with a fallback if it can't be parsed.

## API
- `ParseOptions`
- `StructuredParser`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
